name: Stackid
look: a little cairn of stones with faces: a grey bottom stone with slit eyes and pebble hands and feet, a grumpy brown stone with a frown, an olive stone with slits, and two pebbles on top
entry: Every stone in its stack has a face and a mood of its own, and they squabble constantly. Travellers who find one standing by a mountain path add a pebble to the top for luck; it pretends not to notice.
how: Wild: common on mountains, hills, highlands and stony shores.
